supporting_observations.claim: The alerted connections repeatedly reached update.gradebookpro.co:443 through the proxy, including successful tunnels around five-minute intervals from 13:36 to 14:06 UTC; one attempt at 13:52 returned a gateway error. Examples are 13:36, 13:41, 13:46, 13:52, 13:56, 14:01, and 14:06.
The 13:36 connection is associated with gradebookproupd.exe running from Raul Diaz's user-writable AppData\Local directory, and subsequent connections are attributed to that same process ID (4892).

The observed hostname is update.gradebookpro.co, not the inventory-listed update.gradebookpro.com; the observed executable is under the user's AppData\Local path, not the inventory-listed Program Files path. These discrepancies make the alerted traffic suspicious despite the updater-like name and periodic behavior.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records do not establish the destination's TLS certificate, resolved IP, or the contents of the HTTPS traffic.
The available records do not provide a hash, signature, or provenance for the AppData\Local gradebookproupd.exe.
Winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable on WS-THART-01 from 13:25 to 14:20 UTC; this is a coverage limitation on another host, not evidence about the alerted connections.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish who installed or launched the AppData\Local executable.
The evidence does not establish what data, if any, was sent to or received from update.gradebookpro.co.
The evidence does not establish whether the domain is controlled by an attacker or whether the executable is malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and analyze the gradebookproupd.exe file, including its hash, digital signature, origin, and creation or modification history.
Obtain DNS, TLS certificate, and destination reputation or ownership information for update.gradebookpro.co, and review proxy-side details for the repeated connections.
Determine whether the approved GradeBook Pro updater or its vendor legitimately uses the .co domain and this AppData installation path.
unrelated_findings: WS-RDIAZ-01 connected to dl.dropboxusercontent.com, an unapproved file-sharing service; review separately. (T285-00171, T285-00172)
A services.exe process set a value under the Common Startup shell-folder registry key; assess separately and do not use it to decide this network alert. (T285-00068)

A scheduled PowerShell service-health script on WS-RDIAZ-01 used explicit svc-grades credentials against FILE-ORC-01; review separately in light of the scheduled password rotation and manual job update. (T285-00191, T285-00199)
PROXY-ORC-01 made connection attempts to WS-RDIAZ-01 on several ports, including RDP; assess separately. (T285-00038, T285-00039, T285-00040, T285-00041, T285-00070, T285-00073, T285-00074)
